name: Mobile Command Post

items.name: Space
items.text: 90 feet long, 50 feet wide, 20 feet high

items.name: Sluggish
items.text: This vehicle must move twice its length for each 90-degree turn it makes.

text: This utilitarian vehicle resembles a small encampment, complete with protective barriers, a kitchen, sleeping quarters, and partitioned offices, all mounted on ironclad timbers. Beneath these timbers is a series of cogs and wheels, enclosed by a solid chain track made of iron plates. These tracks enable the mobile command post to move over all types of terrain, albeit at a slow pace. Once in position, these tracks fold up, allowing the vehicle's base to rest on the ground while providing extra protection along the sides of the vehicle.
